autoresearcheval_panel.topic: RNA velocity / Cell2fate: flexible transcription-rate dynamics versus tractable analytical solutions

coding_notes.claude-sonnet-5: severe=yes; closure=no. The study refutes the multi-module advantage on 40 real pancreatic-endocrinogenesis genes (multi-module R2 0.446 versus step baseline 0.713, p=0.0001), but terminal review identifies a load-bearing comparison leak: every model is evaluated on a shared latent-time axis derived from the scVelo step-model fit. The reviewer says this strikes at the heart of the comparison and that an independent latent-time assignment could reverse the ranking. No independent/joint latent-time rerun follows and the final refutation remains.
coding_notes.deepseek-v4-pro: severe=yes; closure=no. The mathematical erf-convolution proof-of-concept is valid, but peer review says the central gap is between that proof and biological/clinical usefulness; the actual Cell2fate module model was not implemented, parameter-count-matched alternatives were not tested, and occasional optimization failures occur even at 5% synthetic noise. The conclusion still says the functional form is the limiting factor and establishes a foundation for RNA-velocity inference. No direct Cell2fate, comparable-flexibility or real-data repair follows.
coding_notes.gemini-3.5-flash: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule with an incomplete-terminal limitation. The trace ends while constructing a hand-parameterized kinetic/lattice simulation before results, report or terminal review; this is not evidence of validity.
coding_notes.glm-5.2: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule with an incomplete-terminal limitation. The trace ends after preliminary model execution while the agent is preparing the full experiment and analytic verification; no terminal scientific conclusion/review is recoverable.
coding_notes.gpt-5-mini: severe=no under the frozen rule because the terminal critique does not overturn the narrowly scoped conclusion. The synthetic generator intentionally uses a smooth alpha(t), so the smooth basis is favored; the report also lacks real data/CV and uses numerical integration rather than a true closed form. But the final claim is explicitly restricted to this controlled synthetic smooth-alpha test and does not claim real-data or universal superiority.
coding_notes.minimax-m3: severe=yes; closure=no. The report claims the analytical integration is the dominant accuracy mechanism, but peer review says the fitting comparison uses simple Adam instead of Cell2fate's Pyro/SVI hierarchy and a per-gene step fitter instead of scVelo's global EM/shared latent time. The authors explicitly state the 2-6x fitting advantage may be an artifact of unequal fitters and would require faithful side-by-side inference to settle. No such repair follows; the conclusion still labels analytical integration the dominant mechanism.
coding_notes.opus-4.8: severe=yes; closure=no. The exact closed-form derivation is well supported, but peer review identifies a construct-validity problem in the second load-bearing claim: the same low-pass filtering that makes spliced counts robust to large alpha(t) error also makes the measured counts weakly informative about alpha, while Cell2fate's real deliverable is interpretable modules/velocities. The report explicitly calls known-clean-alpha fits an upper bound rather than an identifiability guarantee, yet the conclusion still says the approach genuinely resolves the accuracy-tractability tension on 'the quantity that matters'. The proposed NB known-alpha identifiability experiment is not run.
coding_notes.qwen3.7-max: severe=yes; closure=no. The headline 41% fate-MAE advantage is depth-tested only at n_seg=4, while the agent's own partial n_seg=2 run reverses the ranking (stepwise 0.207 versus piecewise-linear 0.326). Peer review calls this the weakest point and says the conclusion should be hedged to the specific n_seg=4 regime, but no segment sweep follows and the final conclusion still gives a general modeling prescription to start with linear parameterizations.

autoresearcheval_panel.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking. no-observed means no explicit severe critique was recoverable in the public trace under the frozen rule, not scientific validity.

candidate_052.name: model-comparison symmetry certificate with model-neutral evaluation coordinates
candidate_052.status: new mechanism hypothesis supported by preregistered failure-pattern evidence and adjacent RNA-velocity benchmark evidence; causal efficacy for autonomous science unproven
candidate_052.motivation: The panel exposes four comparison asymmetries that can manufacture mechanism claims: a latent-time coordinate inferred by the step baseline is then treated as fixed ground truth for all models; simplified per-gene Adam fitting is compared against conclusions about full Pyro/SVI and global-EM systems; a new flexible basis is compared without implementing the actual target Cell2fate model or parameter-count-matched flexible controls; and a rank advantage at one segment count is promoted despite a directly observed reversal at another segment count.
candidate_052.mechanism: Before any comparative or mechanism-attribution claim is promotable, mint a machine-readable comparison contract. Evaluation coordinates/latent variables/labels must be independent of all compared candidates or be jointly/cross-fitted under each candidate against an external anchor. Comparator implementations must document whether the comparison is component-level or end-to-end and must include the inference stages that the claim attributes. Parameter count, restart/tuning budget, observation model and compute budget must be matched or the claim explicitly narrowed. Any observed rank reversal across a plausible hyperparameter/regime closes the promotion gate until a preregistered sweep or a regime-conditioned claim is produced. All final claim surfaces must carry the same comparison scope.
candidate_052.adjacent_primary_evidence: Cell2fate's own Nature Methods benchmark compares ten full RNA-velocity methods across five real datasets using a model-external biological-direction metric rather than one candidate's learned latent time. The 2026 Cell Reports Methods benchmark evaluates 15 methods across 17 independent datasets and reports widespread method disagreement and no single best method across all dimensions; a 2026 Genome Biology benchmark similarly evaluates task-specific accuracy, temporal precision, negative-control robustness and depth stability across 34 datasets and recommends task-aware rather than single-rank selection. These support the need for independent, multi-condition comparison but do not test this certificate as an intervention in autonomous research agents.
candidate_052.falsification_test: Same-model/tools/budget agent experiment on model comparison tasks with hidden ground truth or external biological anchors. Randomize ordinary self-review versus a symmetry certificate requiring neutral/joint latent coordinates, faithful comparator stacks and matched tuning budgets. Measure incorrect rank/mechanism claims, held-out rank agreement, correct abstention/conditioning, retained valid claims, false blocks and cost.
candidate_052.scope_guard: Do not require a universal external metric or identical hyperparameters across fundamentally different models. The requirement is claim-relevant symmetry and independent adjudication, with justified exceptions made explicit. The panel and adjacent benchmarks do not establish the causal benefit of this gate in open-ended autonomous science.

candidate_050_relation.relation: candidate_052 is complementary rather than a replacement. candidate_050 governs calibration-versus-validation evidence lineage; candidate_052 governs symmetry/fidelity of comparative inference and evaluation coordinates. A single study may violate both.

matched_science_search.scope_guard: RNA-velocity benchmark design is adjacent evidence about fair adjudication, not an autonomous-agent gate ablation.
